answer: An copycat therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 15 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The meadow counter is kept in zephyr and oasis reveals each reset. A bond is refunded only after 15 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 1478 identities would post 948 proofs and burn roughly 56 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
